'''Competitive Missions''' are [[mission]]s in which two randomly assembled teams of eight fight each other until certain victory conditions are achieved. These teams will also enlist the aid of [[NPC]]s to help accomplish their goals. 

Competitive missions are unique to the [[Guild Wars Factions]] campaign and are fought between the [[Luxon]] and [[Kurzick]] factions. These two competitive missions are:
*[[Fort Aspenwood]]
*[[The Jade Quarry]] 

These competitive missions are often played for [[Imperial faction]].

== Notes ==
* Each of these missions has a quest available in the daily [[Zaishen Combat]] rotation, which draws a greater number of players than usual to one or the other event on the days that they come up on.
